2. `FlowGraph` implements `FlowNetwork`, adding the neighbor scan internally
3. All algorithm types (`AugmentingPath`, `MaxFlowAlgorithm`, `FordFulkerson`) switch from `FlowGraph` to `FlowNetwork`, so `bfs` can use the named method instead of the raw index loop
